name: Evidence Handling
description: Ability to properly collect, preserve, document, and store evidence from security engagements and investigations. Covers chain of custody, integrity verification (hashing), secure storage, and evidence lifecycle management aligned with ISO/IEC 27037 (identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of digital evidence), ISO/IEC 17025:2017 clause 7.4 (handling of test items), and ACPO/NPCC good practice principles.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to evidence handling procedures

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands why evidence integrity matters and basic chain of custody concepts
evidence: Can explain chain of custody and why it matters
Understands the concept of evidence integrity and hashing

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Follows evidence handling procedures under supervision
evidence: Computes and records integrity hashes under guidance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently handles evidence with full procedural compliance
evidence: Maintains chain of custody across engagements without errors
Handles sensitive and legally relevant evidence appropriately

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex evidence scenarios; reviews evidence packages; improves procedures
evidence: Manages evidence across multi-party and cross-jurisdictional engagements
Reviews evidence handling of junior staff
Contributes to evidence handling procedure updates

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines evidence handling methodology; supports legal proceedings
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's evidence handling framework
Provides expert testimony or declarations on evidence integrity
Trains teams on evidence handling procedures

assessment_methods.description: Observe evidence collection and documentation during a live or simulated engagement
Audit evidence packages from recent engagements for procedural compliance
